messages:
Marta: Evening heads-up — planning a small evening push for the webinar tomorrow. Need an X thread + LinkedIn post. Assets: 1 static hero image + 1 30s clip. Who can pick up scheduling?

Leo: I can schedule the X thread if assets land by 4pm PT. What time are we targeting to publish?

Marta: @Leo target 6:00pm PT for X — peak engagement window 6–8pm. LinkedIn at 6:15pm. Use UTM: ?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=webinar_apr28 (HubSpot).

Jasper: Quick benchmark note — opener should lead with a tight value prop + the throughput stat we tested: '2x inference throughput vs baseline'. Hannah, okay to use that?

Hannah: Confirmed — wording: '2x inference throughput vs. baseline' is safe. CTA = 'Save your seat — link'. Add hubspot params.

Marta: @Sam can you make the 30s clip from the hero recording and export 1080x1080 and 1:1 for X? Need by 3:30pm PT please.

Sam: On it. ETA 3:10pm. Will upload to /assets/social/webinar_apr28/ and paste links here when done.

Nic: I sketched a 5-tweet thread in the draft doc: https://docs.google.com/draft (perm: marketing-edit). TL;DR: hook, stat, 3 quick benefits, CTA. Want to A/B headline for LI.

Leo: :thinking_face: For X, use the curious hook. Example first tweet: 'What if inference cost could halve?' For LI we can test 'Reduce inference costs by 50%' (urgent).

Marta: Curious hook for X main. LI headline = A/B test (curious vs urgent). Keep the thread replies concise.

SocialBot: Reminder: LinkedIn posts must be <= 1300 chars per current API. Attachments OK (mp4 <50MB).

Jasper: Also plan an engagement follow-up: SDR comment push within first 24h. @Jade-sales can you mobilize 3 SDRs to comment/respond in the first 2 hours after publish?

Jade-sales: Yes — I'll queue 3 reps. Need the top 3 talking points for replies.

Marta: Talking points for SDRs: 1) latency wins — measurable improvements; 2) cost/per-token reduction; 3) predictable rollouts + fallbacks. Keep replies <40 words and include webinar link.

Sam: Assets uploaded: https://files.redwood/webinar_apr28/hero.png and https://files.redwood/webinar_apr28/hero_30s.mp4 (1080x1080).

Leo: Got assets. Scheduling now. Draft X thread copy pasted below for quick review — please flag edits fast.

Leo: ```
Tweet 1: What if inference cost could halve?
Tweet 2: We built Redwood Optimize to cut per-token spend without hurting quality.
Tweet 3: In our benchmark, customers saw 2x inference throughput vs. baseline.
Tweet 4: Live demo + walkthrough in our webinar — short, actionable.
Tweet 5: Save your seat: https://redwood.ai/webinar?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=webinar_apr28
```

Nic: Copy looks good. Minor tweak: change 'customers saw' -> 'teams saw' for broader appeal.

Jasper: Also add a pinned reply with TL;DR + registration link so it stays visible.

Marta: Good call. @Leo when scheduled, drop the scheduled time here and mark as 'A' for main LI variant and 'B' for alt. We'll let JADE run the SDR comments and report engagement counts after 24h.

Leo: Scheduled X thread for 1801960800 (6:00pm PT). LinkedIn scheduled 1801960915 (6:15pm PT). A = curious LI headline, B = urgent LI headline.

Jade-sales: SDRs prepped. I'll post a 24h follow-up doc with comment snippets and engagement metrics.

Marta: Perfect — thanks all. If anything changes, ping #marketing-ops. :rocket:
